notes.title: Now live: Necrology, an easier way to access the beta and bugfixes
notes.notes:
Necrology (currently in the beta only!)
We've added a necrology to the game!

This lists all your fallen soldiers, along with the cause of their deaths. Deaths are easy to miss sometimes, and as a new player their cause might not be fully understood, so this should help you figure out why a soldier might have fallen and how to avoid it next time.
[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/4be781df7a1466b872355bf542440f1ce8b278c6.png"]An easier way to switch between branches
You can now easily switch to the beta branch (and back to the default one, if you like) right from the main menu!

Keep in mind that this option only shows up if you have the game's language set to English.

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45586759/1a575c9d55610266b8ada15b416f6829fc53ea20.png"]


Full patch notes:Main Game Version 1.0.0.2
Added a button to switch between beta and stable builds in-game.

Fixed the “Accept all the different opportunity types” achievement being ungettable.

Fixed the promoted version of Margrave Mizla and his successor giving less power than specified.

Fixed Borbak, long-neck liaison activating with Robert Horka’s arrow.

Fixed Mercer Tarcha occasionally not giving armor to adjacent cards.

Slightly changed the behaviour of Ibran, eager scout.

Translation improvements for Simplified Chinese and Traditional Chinese.


Beta Version 1.0.1.1e
You can now switch to this version from the main menu! Alternatively, right click the game in Steam and go to Properties > Betas.

All fixes and changes from Version 1.0.0.2

Added Necrology, a list of all card deaths with their causes.

Fixed Hugo dying after winning a battle if the card was previously a Papery Infantry.

notes.title: Update v1.0.0.1
notes.notes:
Fixed crash when getting the revive wheel reward twice with only one dead card,
 Fixed crash that occasionally occurred when saving and reloading at the final boss,
 Fixed Borka and Geiza giving 9999 base power blood infusions,
 Fixed copying a card onto a letter card at the Royal Copier killing the card at the end of a turn,
 Fixed nitwits softlocking the game in one-lane battles,
 Fixed fomite not getting educated,
 Fixed Book of Fungi not working correctly,
 Fixed Golden chainmail not updating card’s visuals when activated,
 Fixed cards flipping up without being drawn when activated,
 Fixed Guild’s token not giving equipment to some cards,
 Fixed "Packing a Punch" achievement being unachievable,
 Fixed Ipoi not working correctly with Feathers,
 Fixed anointed Arkosh having 0% extra power

notes.title: The Release Date Hath Been Revealed!
notes.notes:
Hear ye, hear ye! 

The moment ye have all been awaiting has arrived! Following our grand reveal at the Secret Sauce Showcase, we are thrilled to announce that The Royal Writ shall be released upon the realm to all you eager and loyal subjects on August 7th!  



Mark thy calendars, for on this auspicious date, all strategists may finally command their full army of warriors in the complete campaign of sacrifice and glory! 



[dynamiclink href="https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=rkAY-R_v4sY"][/dynamiclink]
🎬 New Trailer!
Our court scribes have prepared moving images to commemorate this momentous occasion! Witness the splendour that awaits thee in our official release date trailer - 



[dynamiclink href="https://youtu.be/R107fWXePy8?feature=shared"][/dynamiclink]



The time draws near when permanent consequences and strategic sacrifice shall be yours to command in full!



Be sure to wishlist The Royal Writ and join the Discord legion to stay up to date with all things The Royal Writ. Fear not - our demo shall tide thee over until the glorious day!



[dynamiclink href="https://store.steampowered.com/app/3710820/The_Royal_Writ_Demo/"][/dynamiclink]



P.S., did you hear Ludwig call our game very wishlistable? He's not wrong. It is. It's addictive. Sometimes I play it for so long I forget I'm actually meant to be working.
